site.title: Hyeon Jun Lim
site.description: Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company. Reinforcement learning, end-to-end planning, and LiDAR perception for autonomous driving.

profile.name: Hyeon Jun Lim
profile.affiliation: Autonomous Driving Development, Hyundai Motor Company
bio: I build a closed-loop reinforcement learning framework for autonomous driving, as a Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company.

I have also developed an end-to-end autonomous driving system and ran it on a real vehicle, built a LiDAR perception system for Lv.3 and Lv.4 autonomous driving, and constructed KODAS, Korea's first large-scale autonomous driving dataset.
My goal is to develop scalable reinforcement learning methods and frameworks for real-world autonomous systems, closing the gap between learning in simulation and reliable operation.

projects.title: Unified Closed-Loop Simulation Framework for Reinforcement Learning-Based Autonomous Driving
projects.summary: Building a closed-loop RL training framework that supports multiple environment representations (3DGS scenes, graphics-based simulation, and object-level abstractions), along with scalable RL algorithms across synthetic, reconstructed, and real-world driving data.

projects.title: End-to-End Autonomous Planning System
projects.summary: Co-developed a transformer-based end-to-end planner, built its training and inference framework, and led its embedded deployment and validation on a real vehicle.

projects.title: Lv.3 / Lv.4 Autonomous Driving Perception Systems (HDP & Robo-Services)
projects.summary: Designed the software architecture of the LiDAR perception stack for Lv.3 and Lv.4 platforms, spanning clustering, localization, and online calibration, and led sensor evaluation and the point cloud pre-processing pipeline, CUDA-optimized for the embedded target.

projects.title: River Management Technology Using a Drone-Based Survey Platform
projects.summary: Built a high-fidelity LiDAR simulation framework to derive hardware specifications and validate dual-wavelength bathymetric sensing for river and subsurface mapping.

projects.title: 3D Vehicle Shape Generation System for Automated Car Wash
projects.summary: Developed a multi-LiDAR vehicle-profiling system with sub-2 cm accuracy for unmanned car-wash automation, running in real time on TI embedded hardware.

projects.title: Standardized Open Database and Evaluation System for Intelligent Vehicle Perception
projects.summary: Built the Korea Dataset for Autonomous Solution (KODAS), the first large-scale autonomous driving dataset in Korea, with over a million labeled objects captured by 128-channel LiDAR, and developed its cm-level HD mapping, point cloud processing toolchain, and multi-sensor calibration.

projects.title: Vision-IMU Integrated Indoor Navigation System for the Visually Impaired
projects.summary: Developed an indoor positioning system combining marker-based visual recognition with smartphone IMU dead-reckoning, and built the guidance pipeline around it with a control server, a mobile app, and A*-based safety-aware routing.
